after.hourglass/timesheet.py:
"""Weekly timesheet rows built from a list of shifts."""

from typing import Dict, Iterable, List
from hourglass.schedule import worker_minutes
from hourglass.models import Shift
from hourglass.errors import ProjectError
from collections import Counter


# ---
def timesheet_lines(shifts: Iterable[Shift]) -> List[str]:
    """One line per worker, busiest first, ties by name."""
    items = list(shifts)
    _check_shifts(items)
    totals = worker_minutes(items)
    counts = Counter(item.worker for item in items)
    names = _ranked(totals)
    return [_row(name, counts, totals) for name in names]


def _check_shifts(items: List[Shift]) -> None:
    if not items:
        raise ProjectError("no shifts to total")
    if any(not item.worker.strip() for item in items):
        raise ProjectError("shift has a blank worker name")


def _ranked(totals: Dict[str, int]) -> List[str]:
    return sorted(totals, key=lambda who: (-totals[who], who))


def _row(name: str, counts: Counter, totals: Dict[str, int]) -> str:
    hours = totals[name] / 60
    return f"{name}: {counts[name]} shifts, {hours:.1f} hours"
